[page[title]]

A processing service may use only one foundation service and no higher-level service.

What the Standard says

“One-Foundation” — A processing service depends on one foundation service and adds logic around that single dependency. Work spanning several foundations belongs in orchestration instead. read it here.

Why it matters

A processing service extends one foundation with model-level workflows such as list processing or calculation. Depending on more foundations or on higher layers changes that responsibility into orchestration and makes the layer boundary dishonest.

Bad code example

// Violates STXP001: A processing service may use only one foundation service and no higher-level service.
class StudentProcessingService(
    IStudentService students,
    ICourseService courses) : IStudentProcessingService { }

Good code example

// Follows STXP001
class StudentProcessingService(IStudentService students) : IStudentProcessingService { }
